notes: The author double-posted this list the same day; DeckTech 21635 is the other copy (its starting header reads 7) and is not dested separately.

Starting 8 as posted: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time, Prepared Defenses, I'm Sorry, You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points, Fear Is My Ally, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Crush The Rebellion, Cloud City: Port Town District.
Fear Is My Ally is posted inside Starting and counted in the 60.
Section headers read Characters (15) and Starships (13) but list 16 and 11 cards; dested as listed (60).

Posted 'The signal x2' in this Dark deck dested Twi'lek Advisor x2, the Dark counterpart of the Light interrupt The Signal; the strategy names 'the two twi leks' as the way to get They Must Never Again Leave This City out.
Posted 'Cloud City Landing Platform' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay), the Dark Cloud City docking bay (strategy: 'pull the landing place').

Posted 'Secret Plans/IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans; 'You cannot hide forever/Mob Points' dested You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points; 'Omni box combo' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse.

Posted 'Prepped Defences' dested Prepared Defenses; 'Boba Fett with toy' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Cloud City Carbon Freezing Chamber' dested Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber; 'Bossk In Hounds Tooth' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth.
Bespin, Bespin: Cloud City, Downtown Plaza, Carbonite Chamber, Upper Plaza Corridor and Lobot dested as the Dark Side cards.
